title: CHildhood Allergy and tolerance: bioMarkers and Predictors
summary: Goal of the consortium is to determine factors that influence the occurence, severity and remission of a number of allergic diseases, e.g. food allergy, atopic dermitits, asthma and allergic rhinitis during childhood. Clinically relevant biomarkers should be defined to predict the course of the disease. Furthermore we would like to identify molecular mechanisms for the development of tolerance in allergic diseases. By developing a molecular allergy score it should be possible to determine the risk of a certain allergic disease in early childhood to be followed by a personalised treatment. Therefore six partner institutes are colaborating.
conditions: Allergic and dietetic gastroenteritis and colitis
Anaphylactic shock due to adverse food reaction
